dialogues.jp: 白い天井が見える。
dialogues.en: I gazed at the white clouds above.
dialogues.text: I gazed at the white clouds above.

dialogues.jp: ここは病院なのだろう。
dialogues.en: So this is a hospital...
dialogues.text: So this is a hospital...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ベッドに寝て、真っ白い天井を見ていた。
dialogues.en:
I was lying on a bed, watching the pure white clouds roll
by.
dialogues.text:
I was lying on a bed, watching the pure white clouds roll
by.

dialogues.jp: 杉並の苦笑する顔が見える。
dialogues.en: Suginami's face then popped into my view.
dialogues.text: Suginami's face then popped into my view.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「心配するな。後は俺に任せておけ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. Leave the rest to me."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. Leave the rest to me."

dialogues.jp: 杉並らしくない、しおらしい表情だ。
dialogues.en: A serious face, very unlike him.
dialogues.text: A serious face, very unlike him.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前はただ、そこでおとなしくしていればい
　い……。わかったな」
dialogues.en: "You just stay here and be a good boy... understand?"
dialogues.text: "You just stay here and be a good boy... understand?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は力無く答えた。
dialogues.en: I feebly answered.
dialogues.text: I feebly answered.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺は月城嬢のところに行ってくる。
　そろそろ彼女にも知らせないとな」
dialogues.en:
"I'll head for Tsukishiro-jou's location now, then... it's
time for her to find out."
dialogues.text:
"I'll head for Tsukishiro-jou's location now, then... it's
time for her to find out."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "...Please."
dialogues.text: "...Please."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、動くことができない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't move from my bed.
dialogues.text: I couldn't move from my bed.

dialogues.jp: しばらく、視点は杉並を追いかけることになる。
dialogues.en: Suginami's figure quickly disappeared from my vision.
dialogues.text: Suginami's figure quickly disappeared from my vision.

dialogues.jp:
あいつのことは、美春がきちんと追いかけてく
れるはずだ……。
dialogues.en: Miharu will probably cover for me now...
dialogues.text: Miharu will probably cover for me now...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ゆっくりと目を｛つむ／瞑｝った。
dialogues.en: I slowly closed my eyes.
dialogues.text: I slowly closed my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ嬢、急いで行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Puppy, let us hurry."
dialogues.text: "Puppy, let us hurry."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、行きましょう！」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I'm ready!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, I'm ready!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんせ、一大事だからな……」
dialogues.en: "This is as serious as it gets, after all..."
dialogues.text: "This is as serious as it gets, after all..."

dialogues.jp:
ここからは、しばらく朝倉先輩に代わり、美春
が杉並先輩を追いかけます。
dialogues.en:
From now on, in Asakura-senpai's place, Miharu will cover
the following of Suginami.
dialogues.text:
From now on, in Asakura-senpai's place, Miharu will cover
the following of Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
杉並先輩は、走りながら、連絡をもらっていた
通りに、美春と合流しました。
dialogues.en:
Suginami-senpai was running past junctions and streets, and
I did my best to follow him.
dialogues.text:
Suginami-senpai was running past junctions and streets, and
I did my best to follow him.

dialogues.jp:
そして、美春達は急いで月城さんのおうちを目
指しました。
dialogues.en: Shortly after, Tsukishiro's home came into view.
dialogues.text: Shortly after, Tsukishiro's home came into view.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ、はぁ……杉並先輩、タクシーの方が早
　くないですか？　ここから月城さんちまでは
　随分ありますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, wouldn't a taxi be faster? To
get to Tsukishiro-san's place..."
dialogues.text:
"Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, wouldn't a taxi be faster? To
get to Tsukishiro-san's place..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。事態は一刻を争うからな。できる
　限り早い方がいい」
dialogues.en:
"True. Considering the circumstances, we must do everything
we can to extend what little time we have."
dialogues.text:
"True. Considering the circumstances, we must do everything
we can to extend what little time we have."

dialogues.jp:
杉並先輩はそう言って、スピードを落とし、近
くの手頃なタクシーを停めました。
dialogues.en:
As he spoke, he slowed down his speed, and hailed a nearby
taxi.
dialogues.text:
As he spoke, he slowed down his speed, and hailed a nearby
taxi.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、はぁ、杉並先輩、足早いです……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, you run really fast..."
dialogues.text: "Hah, hahh... Suginami-senpai, you run really fast..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わんこのくせにだらしがないぞ。鍛えておか
　ないとこんな時に困るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I cannot wait for any puppy. Every second is vital."
dialogues.text: "I cannot wait for any puppy. Every second is vital."

dialogues.jp:
杉並先輩は、病院からずっと走っているはずな
のに、ほとんど汗をかいていませんでした。
dialogues.en:
Despite running all the way from the hospital to here,
Suginami-senpai didn't seem to even sweat one drop.
dialogues.text:
Despite running all the way from the hospital to here,
Suginami-senpai didn't seem to even sweat one drop.

dialogues.jp:
タクシーには、急いでいるからと伝え、少しだ
け多めにスピードを出してもらいました。
dialogues.en:
We implored the taxi driver to go faster, and the taxi
increased it's speed bit by bit.
dialogues.text:
We implored the taxi driver to go faster, and the taxi
increased it's speed bit by bit.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、杉並先輩は、イライラしているのか、
ずっと指で膝を叩いていました。
dialogues.en:
But Suginami-senpai still seemed nervous and fidgety,
tapping his finger on his knee irratatedly.
dialogues.text:
But Suginami-senpai still seemed nervous and fidgety,
tapping his finger on his knee irratatedly.

dialogues.jp:
親友の朝倉先輩の一大事なのですから、仕方あ
りません。
dialogues.en:
It can't be helped... it's such a serious amtter involving
his best friend.
dialogues.text:
It can't be helped... it's such a serious amtter involving
his best friend.

dialogues.jp:
美春だって、連絡をもらった時はすごくびっく
りしました。
dialogues.en: When I heard it myself, I was so shocked as well...
dialogues.text: When I heard it myself, I was so shocked as well...

dialogues.jp:
早く病院にいきたかったけれど、杉並先輩の
『月城嬢に知らせなくては』との一言で、先
にそっちへ向かうことになったのです。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to go straight to the hospital, but Suginami-senpai
said that Tsukishiro still hadn't heard, and rushed towards
her home.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to go straight to the hospital, but Suginami-senpai
said that Tsukishiro still hadn't heard, and rushed towards
her home.

dialogues.jp:
タクシーは随分スピードを出していたけれど、
美春は心の中で、ずっと『もっと速く、もっと
速く』と呟いていました。
dialogues.en:
The taxi was moving even faster than the speed limit here,
yet my heart was still pleading it to go faster and faster.
dialogues.text:
The taxi was moving even faster than the speed limit here,
yet my heart was still pleading it to go faster and faster.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「急ぎましょう……杉並先輩」
dialogues.en: "Let's hurry... Suginami-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Let's hurry... Suginami-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わかっている。遅れないようにちゃんとつい
　てくるんだぞ」
dialogues.en: "I know. You better not slow me down."
dialogues.text: "I know. You better not slow me down."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい！　頑張ります」
dialogues.en: "I won't! I'd do my best!"
dialogues.text: "I won't! I'd do my best!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「なんですと！？　今、なんとおっしゃいまし
　た？」
dialogues.en: "W, what in the name of...!? What did you just say!?"
dialogues.text: "W, what in the name of...!? What did you just say!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、はぁ……、だから、朝倉先輩が」
dialogues.en: "Haah, haah... Asakura-senpai, is..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah... Asakura-senpai, is..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「早く月城嬢を呼んできてくれ、セバスチャン」
dialogues.en: "Call Tsukishiro-jou as fast as possible, Sebastian."
dialogues.text: "Call Tsukishiro-jou as fast as possible, Sebastian."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「承知致しました。お待ちくださいませ」
dialogues.en: "I shall. Please wait a moment."
dialogues.text: "I shall. Please wait a moment."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、急いで階段を駆け上がって、月城
さんを呼んできました。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san hurried up the stairs, and called for
Tsukishiro-san.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san hurried up the stairs, and called for
Tsukishiro-san.

dialogues.jp:
月城さんが、いつになく取り乱した表情で、美
春と杉並先輩を見ました。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro-san looked at us with a confused face.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro-san looked at us with a confused face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「月城嬢よ、落ち着いて聞いてくれ……」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-jou, listen to me calmly and carefully..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-jou, listen to me calmly and carefully..."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城さん。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro-san nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro-san nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉が、事故にあった……。交通事故だ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura met with an accident... a traffic accident."
dialogues.text: "Asakura met with an accident... a traffic accident."

dialogues.jp:
月城さんが息を呑んで、身を乗り出してきまし
た。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro-san inhaled suddenly, and leaned forward.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro-san inhaled suddenly, and leaned forward.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今、病院にいる。月城嬢にも知らせなければ
　と思って、急いでやってきた」
dialogues.en:
"He's in the hospital right now. I thought you may not have
known, so we came here as fast as we could."
dialogues.text:
"He's in the hospital right now. I thought you may not have
known, so we came here as fast as we could."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, is..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, is..."

dialogues.jp:
その時、美春には月城さんが唾を飲み込む音が
聞こえたような気がしました。
dialogues.en:
I heard Tsukishiro swallow deeply, as she digested what
Suginami said.
dialogues.text:
I heard Tsukishiro swallow deeply, as she digested what
Suginami said.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さん、行きましょう、朝倉先輩のところ
　へ……」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san, let's go, to where Asakura-senpai is..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san, let's go, to where Asakura-senpai is..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai!!"
dialogues.text: "...Senpai!!"

dialogues.jp:
その瞬間、月城さんが、玄関に向かって、走り
出しました。
dialogues.en:
At that moment, Tsukishiro-san jumped up and dashed towards
the entranceway.
dialogues.text:
At that moment, Tsukishiro-san jumped up and dashed towards
the entranceway.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「月城さんッ！」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san!"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「杉並様……まさか」
dialogues.en: "Suginami-senpai... are you..."
dialogues.text: "Suginami-senpai... are you..."

dialogues.jp:
いつも落ち着いていた瀬場さんも表情を強ばら
せ、杉並先輩を問いただします。
dialogues.en:
Even the ever-calm Seiba-san's face had hardened with shock,
as he questioned Suginami-senpai.
dialogues.text:
Even the ever-calm Seiba-san's face had hardened with shock,
as he questioned Suginami-senpai.

dialogues.jp:
杉並先輩は、何も言わず、ただゆっくりと頷い
ていました。
dialogues.en:
Suginami-senpai, simply, slowly and wordlessly, nodded to
him.
dialogues.text:
Suginami-senpai, simply, slowly and wordlessly, nodded to
him.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、セバスチャン、行ってくる」
dialogues.en: "Sebastian, we're going now."
dialogues.text: "Sebastian, we're going now."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「はい、お嬢様を、よろしくお願い致します」
dialogues.en: "Alright. Please take care of the mistress."
dialogues.text: "Alright. Please take care of the mistress."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、任しておいてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, leave it to me."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, leave it to me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ嬢、月城嬢を追うぞッ」
dialogues.en: "Puppy, we're going to chase after Tsukishiro-jou."
dialogues.text: "Puppy, we're going to chase after Tsukishiro-jou."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はっ、はいい！」
dialogues.en: "Y, yesss!"
dialogues.text: "Y, yesss!"

dialogues.jp:
美春達は、急いで屋敷を出て、タクシーを探し
ました。
dialogues.en: We hurried out of the mansion, and looked for the taxi.
dialogues.text: We hurried out of the mansion, and looked for the taxi.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わんこ嬢……。タクシーを待たせておかなかっ
　たのか？」
dialogues.en: "Dear puppy... did you tell the taxi to wait for us?"
dialogues.text: "Dear puppy... did you tell the taxi to wait for us?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ。あわわ、そうでした！」
dialogues.en: "Eh? A, awahwah, I forgot!"
dialogues.text: "Eh? A, awahwah, I forgot!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、仕方ない。月城嬢よ、走れるか？」
dialogues.en: "Ugh, what's done is done... Tsukishiro-jou, can you run?"
dialogues.text: "Ugh, what's done is done... Tsukishiro-jou, can you run?"

dialogues.jp:
月城さんは、こくんと頷くと、病院のある方向
へ走り出しました。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san, with a quick nod, ran off in the direction
of the hospital.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san, with a quick nod, ran off in the direction
of the hospital.

dialogues.jp: それを杉並先輩が追いかけます。
dialogues.en: Suginami-senpai followed immediately after.
dialogues.text: Suginami-senpai followed immediately after.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「水越総合病院だ！　わかるか？」
dialogues.en: "It's the Mizukoshi Hospital! Do you know where it is?"
dialogues.text: "It's the Mizukoshi Hospital! Do you know where it is?"

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷きながらも、走る月城さん。
dialogues.en: Without slowing her pace, Tsukishiro-san nodded in reply.
dialogues.text: Without slowing her pace, Tsukishiro-san nodded in reply.

dialogues.jp:
杉並さんまでもが離されるくらいのものすごい
スピードです。
dialogues.en:
Her speed was so amazing, that it was leaving even
Suginami-senpai in the dust.
dialogues.text:
Her speed was so amazing, that it was leaving even
Suginami-senpai in the dust.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、はぁ、杉並先輩……美春は……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, haah, Suginami-senpai... I'm..."
dialogues.text: "Hah, haah, Suginami-senpai... I'm..."

dialogues.jp:
さすがにバナナのスタミナパワーにも限界があ
りました。
dialogues.en:
I guess the stamina power of bananas has reached it's
limit...
dialogues.text:
I guess the stamina power of bananas has reached it's
limit...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉の家に自転車があるはずだ。鍵は、ポス
　トの中にある！」
dialogues.en:
"There's a bicycle at Asakura's house! The key's in the
mailbox!"
dialogues.text:
"There's a bicycle at Asakura's house! The key's in the
mailbox!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「は、はいぃぃ……」
dialogues.en: "O, okayyy...."
dialogues.text: "O, okayyy...."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、杉並先輩の言うとおり、朝倉先輩のお
うちで自転車をお借りし、走らせます。
dialogues.en:
Just as Suginami-senpai said, there was a bicycle at
Asakura's house. I borrowed it for a short while, and headed
onwards.
dialogues.text:
Just as Suginami-senpai said, there was a bicycle at
Asakura's house. I borrowed it for a short while, and headed
onwards.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺はいいから、月城嬢を……。くッ……、こ
　の俺が遅れを取るとは……」
dialogues.en:
"I'd be fine, just watch for Tsukshiro-jou.... ugh... looks
like I'd be there late..."
dialogues.text:
"I'd be fine, just watch for Tsukshiro-jou.... ugh... looks
like I'd be there late..."

dialogues.jp:
月城さんの足はとても速く、美春が自転車を一
生懸命漕いで、ようやく追いつくスピードでし
た。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san's pace was blazingly quick, but with me
pedaling with all I had, I managed to catch up to her.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san's pace was blazingly quick, but with me
pedaling with all I had, I managed to catch up to her.

dialogues.jp:
子どもの頃にサーカスで働いていたというのは
ダテじゃないということでしょうか。
dialogues.en:
The training she received at the circus when she was a child
really hasn't gone to waste.
dialogues.text:
The training she received at the circus when she was a child
really hasn't gone to waste.

dialogues.jp:
美春だって、早く先輩のところへ行きたいんだ
から、もっと速く漕がないと……。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to reach where senpai was faster as well, but my
feet couldn't pedal any faster than they were now...
dialogues.text:
I wanted to reach where senpai was faster as well, but my
feet couldn't pedal any faster than they were now...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ふぅ、はぁ、ふぅ、月城さん……乗って……
　行きますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Haah, haah, haah, Tsukishiro-san... do you... want to get
on...?"
dialogues.text:
"Haah, haah, haah, Tsukishiro-san... do you... want to get
on...?"

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を横に振る月城さん。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro-san simply shook her head.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro-san simply shook her head.

dialogues.jp:
月城さんは、少しだけ前傾姿勢になり、さらに
スピードをあげました。
dialogues.en:
Then, tilting her body slightly forward, somehow moved up a
gear and accelerated.
dialogues.text:
Then, tilting her body slightly forward, somehow moved up a
gear and accelerated.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "......Senpai."
dialogues.text: "......Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai..."

dialogues.jp:
月城さんは、荒い呼吸でずっと朝倉先輩の名前
を呼んでいました。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san constantly repeated Asakura-senpai's name in
between her quick breaths.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san constantly repeated Asakura-senpai's name in
between her quick breaths.

dialogues.jp:
すごく、不安そうな……、見ている方も胸がきゅ
うっと締め付けられそうなくらいの、苦しそう
な表情。
dialogues.en:
She's really worried... just looking at her pained face,
made my chest tighten up as well.
dialogues.text:
She's really worried... just looking at her pained face,
made my chest tighten up as well.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……ふぅ、ふぅ、頑張りましょう、月城さん」
dialogues.en: "...Haah, haah... keep going, Tsukishiro-san!"
dialogues.text: "...Haah, haah... keep going, Tsukishiro-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay!"
dialogues.text: "...Okay!"

dialogues.jp:
一生懸命走っているうちに、なんとか病院に到
着しました。
dialogues.en:
Moving as quickly as we humanly could, we reached the
hospital.
dialogues.text:
Moving as quickly as we humanly could, we reached the
hospital.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「すいません……あの、朝倉さんの入院してい
　る部屋は……」
dialogues.en:
"Excuse me... may I know which ward Asakura-san is staying
in...?"
dialogues.text:
"Excuse me... may I know which ward Asakura-san is staying
in...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「はい？　朝倉……さんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? Asakura...-san, you say?"
dialogues.text: "Yes? Asakura...-san, you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ嬢、月城嬢、こっちだ！」
dialogues.en: "Puppy, Tsukishiro-jou, here!"
dialogues.text: "Puppy, Tsukishiro-jou, here!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「は、はいぃぃッ！」
dialogues.en: "O, okaayyyy!"
dialogues.text: "O, okaayyyy!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay!"
dialogues.text: "...Okay!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並先輩の案内で、朝倉先輩の入っている病室
に向かいます。
dialogues.en:
With Suginami-senpai's guidance, we entered Asakura-senpai's
hospital room.
dialogues.text:
With Suginami-senpai's guidance, we entered Asakura-senpai's
hospital room.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura!!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura!!"

dialogues.jp:
個室になっているそこには、朝倉先輩がベッド
で寝ていました。
dialogues.en:
Asakura-senpai appeared to be unconscious, lying in bed in a
private room.
dialogues.text:
Asakura-senpai appeared to be unconscious, lying in bed in a
private room.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉……先輩」
dialogues.en: "Asakura...senpai..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura...senpai..."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、事故だってことをここでようやく理解
することができたような気がします。
dialogues.en:
The realization that he was in accident was beginning to
sink in.
dialogues.text:
The realization that he was in accident was beginning to
sink in.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai!"
dialogues.text: "...Senpai!"

dialogues.jp:
後ろにいた月城さんが、美春を押しのけて、先
輩のところに駆け寄りました。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san pushed me out of the way from behind, and
rushed over to Asakura-senpai's side.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san pushed me out of the way from behind, and
rushed over to Asakura-senpai's side.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お、おい、月城嬢……、そんなにゆらしちゃ
　ダメだ！」
dialogues.en: "O, oy, Tsukishiro-jou... don't shake him like that!"
dialogues.text: "O, oy, Tsukishiro-jou... don't shake him like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「…………死なないで」
dialogues.en: "...Don't die..."
dialogues.text: "...Don't die..."

dialogues.jp:
いつになく、月城さんの声が強く、感情的に思
えました。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san's voice was unusually strong, filled with
emotion.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san's voice was unusually strong, filled with
emotion.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩、死なないで！」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai, don't die!"
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai, don't die!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「…………死なないで、先輩には、朝倉先輩に
　は、……あなたには死んで欲しくないの！」
dialogues.en: "...Don't die, I, I.. I don't want you to die!"
dialogues.text: "...Don't die, I, I.. I don't want you to die!"

dialogues.jp: ｛せき／堰｝を切ったように強く言葉を発する月城さん。
dialogues.en:
She spoke strongly, firing off what she wanted to say and
not holding back.
dialogues.text:
She spoke strongly, firing off what she wanted to say and
not holding back.

dialogues.jp:
月城さんは、精一杯、自分の気持ちを、言葉に
しているように思えました。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro-san was finally speaking, with all her heart, her
own feelings.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro-san was finally speaking, with all her heart, her
own feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……私は、……先輩が、……好きです！　ずっ
　と側にいてほしい、いなくならないで！」
dialogues.en:
"...I... Senpai, I... I love you! I want you by my side
forever, never going away!"
dialogues.text:
"...I... Senpai, I... I love you! I want you by my side
forever, never going away!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「つ、月城……苦しい……」
dialogues.en: "T, Tsukishiro... it hurts..."
dialogues.text: "T, Tsukishiro... it hurts..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……く、首、締まってる」
dialogues.en: "...You're... strangling me..."
dialogues.text: "...You're... strangling me..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Ehh? ...Ehhh?"
dialogues.text: "...Ehh? ...Ehhh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、……バカめ」
dialogues.en: "Pah... what an idiot."
dialogues.text: "Pah... what an idiot."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……杉並先輩、これって……」
dialogues.en: "Um, ah... Suginami-senpai, this is..."
dialogues.text: "Um, ah... Suginami-senpai, this is..."

dialogues.jp: ──バン！
dialogues.en: --*bang!*
dialogues.text: --*bang!*

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっとぉ！　心の病気を治す手伝いはして
　あげるって言ったけど、人の恋路の手伝いを
　するなんて聞いてないわよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Hold it! I said we'd help to heal a person's heart
problems, but I don't remember promising to help romantic
pursuits!"
dialogues.text:
"Hold it! I said we'd help to heal a person's heart
problems, but I don't remember promising to help romantic
pursuits!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ま、眞子先輩！？」
dialogues.en: "M, Mako-senpai!?"
dialogues.text: "M, Mako-senpai!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……出てくるなと言っておいただろう」
dialogues.en: "...And here it comes, now..."
dialogues.text: "...And here it comes, now..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もう、見てるとね……、ガマンできなくなっ
　たっていうか」
dialogues.en: "I've seen enough... I can't take much more of this."
dialogues.text: "I've seen enough... I can't take much more of this."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、あたしが朝倉の、恋路を……」
dialogues.en:
"Why am I, of all people, helping with Asakura's love
affairs..."
dialogues.text:
"Why am I, of all people, helping with Asakura's love
affairs..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「杉並先輩、どういうこと……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Suginami-senpai, um... what is happening?"
dialogues.text: "Suginami-senpai, um... what is happening?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩は、もしかして」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai, are you..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai, are you..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……。マズったもんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh boy... now this is what I call awkward."
dialogues.text: "Oh boy... now this is what I call awkward."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、シーツの中からゆっくりと身体を起こす。
dialogues.en:
Still lying under the sheets, I lifted my body into a
seating position.
dialogues.text:
Still lying under the sheets, I lifted my body into a
seating position.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、別に目的は達成できた訳だから、気にす
　るな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, we fulfilled the objective anyway, so I suppose it's
alright."
dialogues.text:
"Well, we fulfilled the objective anyway, so I suppose it's
alright."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……あの、いったいどうなってるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Um, may I know what is going on?"
dialogues.text: "...Um, may I know what is going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「眞子先輩、どういうことですか！」
dialogues.en: "Mako-senpai, what is this!"
dialogues.text: "Mako-senpai, what is this!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……美春ちゃん、聞いてないの？」
dialogues.en: "...Miharu-chan doesn't know about it either?"
dialogues.text: "...Miharu-chan doesn't know about it either?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わんこ嬢に教えたら、うまくいくものもいか
　ないからな」
dialogues.en:
"The plan would've had a much higher chance of failure, if
the dear puppy knew the truth."
dialogues.text:
"The plan would've had a much higher chance of failure, if
the dear puppy knew the truth."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？」
dialogues.en: "Haehh?"
dialogues.text: "Haehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「昨日ね、杉並から連絡があってね。『心に傷
　を持った後輩がいる。助けてやりたいとは思
　わんか』って」
dialogues.en:
"Suginami talked to me yesterday. "I know a lowerclassman
with a heart problem. I want to try and save her."... was
what he said."
dialogues.text:
"Suginami talked to me yesterday. "I know a lowerclassman
with a heart problem. I want to try and save her."... was
what he said."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それで、あたしがお父さんに話をつけて、空
　いてる部屋をひとつ貸してもらったって訳。
　夕方までって約束でね」
dialogues.en:
"So, I talked with my father about it, and managed to get
him to loan one empty room. I promised it to Suginami last
evening."
dialogues.text:
"So, I talked with my father about it, and managed to get
him to loan one empty room. I promised it to Suginami last
evening."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「悪ィ、月城。そういうことだ。俺はこの通り
　事故には遭ってない。元気なままだ」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, Tsukishiro. It's as she says. I didn't get caught in
any accident. I'm still as healthy as ever."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, Tsukishiro. It's as she says. I didn't get caught in
any accident. I'm still as healthy as ever."

dialogues.jp: 作戦は終了って事だ。
dialogues.en: The operation is over, it seems.
dialogues.text: The operation is over, it seems.

dialogues.jp:
「杉並の一計でな。月城は、きっかけがあった
　ら、自分の気持ちを言葉にすることができる
　んじゃないかって」
dialogues.en:
"It was Suginami's plan. He thought that you wouldn't just
be able to start communicating your own feelings by
yourself."
dialogues.text:
"It was Suginami's plan. He thought that you wouldn't just
be able to start communicating your own feelings by
yourself."

dialogues.jp:
「多少強引だけど、ショック療法はどうだって
　話になってな」
dialogues.en:
"What was needed, was a bigger push, shock treatment... you
could say."
dialogues.text:
"What was needed, was a bigger push, shock treatment... you
could say."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょ、ちょっと待ってくださいよ！
　じゃあ、先輩達は揃って美春達を騙したって
　ことですか！？」
dialogues.en:
"W, w, w, wait a minute here! So Suginami and Asakura-senpai
were lying to all of us!?"
dialogues.text:
"W, w, w, wait a minute here! So Suginami and Asakura-senpai
were lying to all of us!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そう……なるかな」
dialogues.en: "Yup... that's pretty much it."
dialogues.text: "Yup... that's pretty much it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「じょ、じょーだんじゃないですよ！　美春達
　がどれだけ先輩のことを心配したか！　ねえ、
　月城さん！」
dialogues.en:
"T, this isn't a joking matter! We were so worried about
you! Right, Tsukishiro-san!?"
dialogues.text:
"T, this isn't a joking matter! We were so worried about
you! Right, Tsukishiro-san!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「怒るべきですよ！　断固！　糾弾ですよ！
　裁判ですよ！」
dialogues.en:
"This is horrible! Completely uncalled for! Terrible!
Atrocious!"
dialogues.text:
"This is horrible! Completely uncalled for! Terrible!
Atrocious!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「でも？」
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……よかった」
dialogues.en: "...I'm glad."
dialogues.text: "...I'm glad."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はえ？」
dialogues.en: "Haeeh?"
dialogues.text: "Haeeh?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……先輩が無事で、よかった。朝倉先輩が、
　なんともなくてよかった……」
dialogues.en:
"...I'm glad Senpai's fine... that Asakura-senpai's still
here..."
dialogues.text:
"...I'm glad Senpai's fine... that Asakura-senpai's still
here..."

dialogues.jp:
月城の目から、ポロポロポロポロと涙がこぼれ
落ちる。
dialogues.en: Tears were rapidly dropping from Tsukishiro's eyes.
dialogues.text: Tears were rapidly dropping from Tsukishiro's eyes.

dialogues.jp:
そして、月城はヒックヒックと嗚咽を漏らしな
がら、俺の手をきゅっと握る。
dialogues.en: I broughy my hand up, wiping them from her soft face.
dialogues.text: I broughy my hand up, wiping them from her soft face.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめんな、月城。悪気はなかったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, Tsukishiro. I didn't mean to trick you..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, Tsukishiro. I didn't mean to trick you..."

dialogues.jp: 目をこすりながら、こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: Rubbing her eyes, Tsukshiro nodded.
dialogues.text: Rubbing her eyes, Tsukshiro nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう、月城……。月城の気持ち、しっ
　かり聞かせてもらったよ」
dialogues.en:
"And, thank you, Tsukishiro... I'm happy to hear your true
feelings."
dialogues.text:
"And, thank you, Tsukishiro... I'm happy to hear your true
feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは、月城嬢よ。その気になってみれ
　ば、自分の気持ちも言えるものだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Ha ha ha, Tsukishiro-jou! Do you not realize that you just
spoke your feelings through your own mouth?"
dialogues.text:
"Ha ha ha, Tsukishiro-jou! Do you not realize that you just
spoke your feelings through your own mouth?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……あ、あの……その」
dialogues.en: "A, ah... that's..."
dialogues.text: "A, ah... that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「自分の気持ちは、自分の言葉で伝える方がい
　いと思うんだが、どうだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't it a good feeling, to say what you truly feel
yourself, to the one you love?"
dialogues.text:
"Isn't it a good feeling, to say what you truly feel
yourself, to the one you love?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……その、……その方がいいと思います」
dialogues.en: "...That's.... that felt very nice."
dialogues.text: "...That's.... that felt very nice."

dialogues.jp:
月城の涙はいつの間にか止まっていた。そして
とてもきれいな笑顔を見せた。
dialogues.en:
Her tears had stopped. Replacing them, on her face, was a
beautiful smile.
dialogues.text:
Her tears had stopped. Replacing them, on her face, was a
beautiful smile.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょっとぉ、月城さんはいいですけど、
　美春はどうなんですかぁ？　騙され損？　巻
　き添え？」
dialogues.en:
"H, hold on! It's fine with Tsukishiro-san, but what about
me? Why did you deceive me? Why did you get me involved?"
dialogues.text:
"H, hold on! It's fine with Tsukishiro-san, but what about
me? Why did you deceive me? Why did you get me involved?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、敵を騙すにはまず味方からって言うだ
　ろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, to trick your enemies, you must first trick your
allies, you could say..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, to trick your enemies, you must first trick your
allies, you could say..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、でも……。う〜ッ、やっぱり納得でき
　ないッ。慰謝料、バナナ１００万本……！」
dialogues.en:
"But, but... grrr, I cannot accept this! I demand
compensation, in the form of 1 million bananas!"
dialogues.text:
"But, but... grrr, I cannot accept this! I demand
compensation, in the form of 1 million bananas!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……わんこ嬢よ。今日は何月の何日だ？」
dialogues.en: "...My dear puppy. What is today's date?"
dialogues.text: "...My dear puppy. What is today's date?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「３月……、あ、今日から４月か。……ええと、
　４月の１日……って、ああ！」
dialogues.en:
"March... ah, it's April today... ermm, April 1st....
ahhhh!"
dialogues.text:
"March... ah, it's April today... ermm, April 1st....
ahhhh!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前もか！」
dialogues.en: "Hah, you too!"
dialogues.text: "Hah, you too!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……エ、エイプリルフール」
dialogues.en: "...A, April Fools..."
dialogues.text: "...A, April Fools..."

dialogues.jp: 俺も言われるまで、気づかなかったよ……。
dialogues.en: Until he said it, I didn't realize either...
dialogues.text: Until he said it, I didn't realize either...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、じゃあ、後は若い二人に任せて、邪魔
　者は退散しようじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"Now then, let's leave the young ones alone. It won't do
good to be crowded now."
dialogues.text:
"Now then, let's leave the young ones alone. It won't do
good to be crowded now."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……もしかして、あたしの出番、これだけ？
　すっごい、損な役回りじゃない？」
dialogues.en:
"...So this was all I had to do? A tiny tiny role, isn't
it?"
dialogues.text:
"...So this was all I had to do? A tiny tiny role, isn't
it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、水越の協力がなかったら、この作
　戦にこれほどのリアリティを出すことはでき
　なかった」
dialogues.en:
"No no, without Mizukoshi's cooperation, this operation
would never even have achieved reality."
dialogues.text:
"No no, without Mizukoshi's cooperation, this operation
would never even have achieved reality."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉は、ドサクサにまぎれて告白なんか
　されちゃうし」
dialogues.en:
"...So my role was to help a girl confess to Asakura in
confusion?"
dialogues.text:
"...So my role was to help a girl confess to Asakura in
confusion?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……あの、先輩……ですよね。……その、私
　のためにご迷惑を……」
dialogues.en:
"...Um, Senpai... I think? I'm sorry for being the source of
the trouble..."
dialogues.text:
"...Um, Senpai... I think? I'm sorry for being the source of
the trouble..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「えっ、あっ、あの、つ、月城さんだっけ？
　いいのよ？　あたしは別に。もともとはあな
　たのためにした訳だし」
dialogues.en:
"Eh, ah, um, Tsukishiro-san, was it? It's fine. I don't have
any problems. This was for your benefit, so..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh, ah, um, Tsukishiro-san, was it? It's fine. I don't have
any problems. This was for your benefit, so..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子がスズメの行水みたいに、手をバタバタと
振る。
dialogues.en: Mako flapped her hand up and down, like a bird.
dialogues.text: Mako flapped her hand up and down, like a bird.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「はい、ここはもう少し使っても大丈夫だから
　あのバカとゆっくりしてってちょうだい」
dialogues.en:
"It should be okay to use the room for a little longer...
don't let the idiot extend it too long, though."
dialogues.text:
"It should be okay to use the room for a little longer...
don't let the idiot extend it too long, though."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「バ、バカとは何だ！」
dialogues.en: "W, who's the idiot!"
dialogues.text: "W, who's the idiot!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたねぇ、この子にあそこまで言わせたん
　だから、ちゃんとしないとあたし許さないか
　らね……」
dialogues.en:
"You, if you don't answer her properly, I won't ever forgive
you. Remember that!"
dialogues.text:
"You, if you don't answer her properly, I won't ever forgive
you. Remember that!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ま、眞子ッ……お前」
dialogues.en: "M, Mako... you..."
dialogues.text: "M, Mako... you..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「では、我々はこれで失礼する。行くぞ、水越、
　わんこ嬢」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps it is time for us to leave. Let's go, Mizukoshi,
puppy."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps it is time for us to leave. Let's go, Mizukoshi,
puppy."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が病室のドアを開ける。
dialogues.en: Suginami opened the door back to the hospital.
dialogues.text: Suginami opened the door back to the hospital.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「──なんか、美春は納得できないですよぅ」
dialogues.en: "--I still can't accept this."
dialogues.text: "--I still can't accept this."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ハイハイ、向こうでゆっくり聞いてあげるか
　ら……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes, we'd hear you out outside..."
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes, we'd hear you out outside..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並と眞子によって、美春はブツブツと言いな
がら外へ連れて行かれた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and Mako dragged the stilll-grumbling Miharu out of
the room, and shut the door.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and Mako dragged the stilll-grumbling Miharu out of
the room, and shut the door.

dialogues.jp: そして、部屋は静かになった。
dialogues.en: The room suddenly became a lot quieter.
dialogues.text: The room suddenly became a lot quieter.

dialogues.jp: 月城と二人っきり。
dialogues.en: Just Tsukshiro and I remained.
dialogues.text: Just Tsukshiro and I remained.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なんだかうまく月城の顔が見ることがで
きずに、ほんの少しだけ目線を逸らして、口を
開く。
dialogues.en:
I stared straight at her face, as she did the same for me. I
slowly opened my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I stared straight at her face, as she did the same for me. I
slowly opened my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……月城？」
dialogues.en: "Um... Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "Um... Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「その……さっきの気持ちって、やっぱり」
dialogues.en: "About... your feelings earlier, were they...?"
dialogues.text: "About... your feelings earlier, were they...?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……はい、あの……その、私は……その先輩
　のことが好きです」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, um... I... I love you, Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, um... I... I love you, Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「好きっていう気持ちが、今の私の気持ちなら、
　ですけど……」
dialogues.en: "The feelings of love I have, but, you don't..."
dialogues.text: "The feelings of love I have, but, you don't..."

dialogues.jp: 月城が頬を赤らめながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro's cheeks turned bright red, as she spoke.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro's cheeks turned bright red, as she spoke.

dialogues.jp: 「ううん、それでも嬉しいよ……」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm very happy..."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm very happy..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「この気持ちは……その、ずっと前からあって、
　けど……言えなくて」
dialogues.en:
"These feelings, they were... I've had them for a while,
but... I couldn't say it."
dialogues.text:
"These feelings, they were... I've had them for a while,
but... I couldn't say it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「月城……。あのさ、俺もさ」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro... it's the same for me too."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro... it's the same for me too."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「俺も月城のことが好きなんだと思う。この胸
　があったかくなるような気持ちが好きって気
　持ちなら」
dialogues.en:
"I think love you too, Tsukishiro. This warm feeling in my
chest, it can't be anything but love."
dialogues.text:
"I think love you too, Tsukishiro. This warm feeling in my
chest, it can't be anything but love."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……それは、私と同じ気持ちですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is that, the same feelings as mine?"
dialogues.text: "...Is that, the same feelings as mine?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……たぶん同じ気持ちだよ。俺も月城のそば
　を離れたくないと思ってる。ずっと一緒にい
　たいと思ってる」
dialogues.en:
"...I think it is. I also don't want to leave your side...
want to be together with you forever."
dialogues.text:
"...I think it is. I also don't want to leave your side...
want to be together with you forever."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.jp: 触れていた月城の手が俺の手を、きゅっと握る。
dialogues.en: OUr hands came together, holding each others' tightly.
dialogues.text: OUr hands came together, holding each others' tightly.

dialogues.jp:
「……ちゃんと、自分の気持ち、伝えられるよ
　うになったな」
dialogues.en: "...And now, you know my true feelings as well."
dialogues.text: "...And now, you know my true feelings as well."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、ゆっくりと、そして強く……こくんと
頷いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro slowly, yet strongly, nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro slowly, yet strongly, nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「みんなに感謝しなきゃな」
dialogues.en: "You should thank everyone as well."
dialogues.text: "You should thank everyone as well."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……そう、ですね。私が、もう１度喋れるよ
　うになったのは、あの先輩達のおかげです」
dialogues.en:
"...That's right. The reason I can talk again, is all thanks
to everyone..."
dialogues.text:
"...That's right. The reason I can talk again, is all thanks
to everyone..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「いや、月城がっていうより、俺が、かな」
dialogues.en:
"But, Tsukishiro, there's one more thing that you and I
forgot to thank."
dialogues.text:
"But, Tsukishiro, there's one more thing that you and I
forgot to thank."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「俺と月城を結び合わせてくれたこと……」
dialogues.en:
"The one thing that brought us together in the first
place..."
dialogues.text:
"The one thing that brought us together in the first
place..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……そう、ですね」
dialogues.en: "...You're right."
dialogues.text: "...You're right."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、笑う。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro smiled.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro smiled.

dialogues.jp: 月城が、笑った。
dialogues.en: Smiling a beautiful smile.
dialogues.text: Smiling a beautiful smile.

dialogues.jp: にっこりと、──笑った。
dialogues.en: The sweetest smile I had ever seen.
dialogues.text: The sweetest smile I had ever seen.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、その笑顔が見たかったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I want to see that smile, closer..."
dialogues.text: "I want to see that smile, closer..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、そんな月城をそっと引き寄せた。
dialogues.en: I brought Tsukishiro closer to me...
dialogues.text: I brought Tsukishiro closer to me...

dialogues.jp: ◆月城の気持ち◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tsukishiro's Feelings◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tsukishiro's Feelings◆

dialogues.jp: きっかけがあればいい。
dialogues.en: This was the start that she needed.
dialogues.text: This was the start that she needed.

dialogues.jp: そう言いだしたのは杉並だった。
dialogues.en: At least, that was what Suginami said.
dialogues.text: At least, that was what Suginami said.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、杉並の言葉を信じるまま、病院のベッド
に入り、待っていた。
dialogues.en:
Believing in Suginami's words, I waited patiently in a bed,
at the hospital.
dialogues.text:
Believing in Suginami's words, I waited patiently in a bed,
at the hospital.

dialogues.jp:
俺が事故だと聞いた月城は、病室に入ってくる
なり、その感情を爆発させた。
dialogues.en:
Hearing that I had met with an accident, Tsukishiro burst
into the hospital room, and her emotions came pouring out.
dialogues.text:
Hearing that I had met with an accident, Tsukishiro burst
into the hospital room, and her emotions came pouring out.

dialogues.jp: 杉並の作戦は、うまくいった訳だ。
dialogues.en: Suginami's operation had worked to perfection.
dialogues.text: Suginami's operation had worked to perfection.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、そんなことよりも、月城が俺のことを
好きだという告白の方がなんだか驚いてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Except, perhaps, it worked even better than it should.
Tsukishiro's confession that she loved me shocked me as
well.
dialogues.text:
Except, perhaps, it worked even better than it should.
Tsukishiro's confession that she loved me shocked me as
well.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺の中にあった｛あいまい／曖昧｝な気持ちも認めざ
るを得なかった。
dialogues.en:
But, it allowed me to acknowledge the vague feelings I had
within me as well.
dialogues.text:
But, it allowed me to acknowledge the vague feelings I had
within me as well.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城のことが好きだ。
dialogues.en: I loved Tsukishiro, too.
dialogues.text: I loved Tsukishiro, too.

dialogues.jp: 互いの気持ちを確かめ合った今、
dialogues.en: At the knowledge that our feelings were mutual,
dialogues.text: At the knowledge that our feelings were mutual,

dialogues.jp: 月城は、──ようやく笑った。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro finally smiled a brilliant smile.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro finally smiled a brilliant smile.
